name: Million Air
desc: Network of about 35 luxury fixed-base operations for business aviation in the US and Canada, founded in Dallas in 1984.
products: FBO terminals, fuel (incl. SAF), hangarage, aircraft management, aircraft sales and acquisitions
customers: Business-jet owners and operators; more than 800 aircraft based in its leaseholds
markets: United States, Canada (Calgary, Vancouver) and the Caribbean

alt_indicators.evidence: network in the US, Canada and the Caribbean; 35 locations

signals.what: Launched a dedicated aircraft sales and acquisitions division

fit_rationale: Premium FBO brand whose clients are private-jet owners flying into Austin, Miami, Las Vegas and Montreal race weekends; hospitality and race-weekend handling packages are a natural use.
outstanding: Owner not stated on its site (founded by the Mary Kay family); no published revenue. Route C indicators exist but ownership must be confirmed before MAIN.

name: Piper Aircraft
desc: Florida maker of piston, trainer and turboprop aircraft (Archer, Seminole, Pilot 100i, M700 Fury), owned by the Government of Brunei since 2009.
products: Archer, Seminole, Pilot 100i trainers; M-Class turboprops incl. M700 Fury
customers: Flight schools (United Aviate Academy, ATP), universities, private owners
marketing_autonomy_basis: Own brand, CEO (John Calcagno) and brand ambassador programme
markets: United States, Europe, Brazil, Australia and other markets via dealers
expansion_markets: Europe via Leading Edge Aviation; new Vero Beach service centre

signals.what: Fleet agreement with ATP Flight School (6 aircraft, options for 25)
European footprint expanded with Leading Edge Aviation (10 Archer DX)
New factory service centre in Vero Beach

fit_rationale: Historic aviation brand with private-owner and flight-school buyers; F1 could support M700 Fury premium positioning, but scale is unproven.
outstanding: No revenue or current headcount found (850 employees cited for 2011); state parent backing not documented.

name: Epirus
desc: US venture-backed developer of the Leonidas high-power microwave system that disables drone swarms, with AI sensor fusion and mission software.
products: Leonidas HPM counter-UAS, Manta AI-enabled sensing, Kosmos mission suite, FISTA RF test solution
customers: US Marine Corps (HAVOC, USD 11m), US Army DEVCOM GVSC, Department of War directed-energy pilot

signals.what: US Marine Corps HAVOC contract of USD 11m
Leonidas selected for Department of War directed-energy pilot programme
Appointed COO and Chief People Officer

fit_rationale: Fast-growing counter-drone specialist hiring RF and power-electronics engineers; F1 would mainly serve talent branding.
outstanding: Funding total and valuation not shown on the pages opened (newsroom returned 503); no route proven.

name: Duncan Aviation
desc: Family-led US business-jet maintenance, avionics, interiors, paint and engine services provider, describing itself as the largest privately owned in the world.
products: Airframe and engine MRO, avionics and connectivity installs, interiors and paint, aircraft sales, rapid-response engine support
customers: Business-jet owners and flight departments worldwide
parent_immediate: Duncan family (privately owned; family leads since 1956)
stores_or_sites: Three major MRO facilities (Michigan, Nebraska, Utah) plus regional satellite shops and rapid-response locations
markets: United States, serving international business-jet operators

signals.what: Reopened engine rapid-response location at Centennial Airport, Colorado
Senior leadership changes at Michigan facilities

fit_rationale: Serves exactly the business-jet owners and flight departments who attend US races; hospitality and private-aviation themed activation at Austin, Miami and Las Vegas fit its customer base.
outstanding: Employee count and revenue not found on pages opened; self-described largest privately owned business-jet service provider is a single self-claim, so no route shown yet.

name: Azercosmos
desc: Azerbaijan's state satellite operator running the Azerspace-1 and Azerspace-2 telecom satellites and the Azersky Earth-observation service.
products: Satellite capacity (Azerspace-1, Azerspace-2), Earth observation imagery (Azersky), teleport services
customers: Broadcasters, telecom operators and governments in Europe, Africa, the Middle East, Caucasus and Central/South Asia
parent_immediate: AZCON Holding (Azerbaijan Transport and Communication Holding)
markets: Coverage of Europe, Africa, the Middle East, the Caucasus, Central and South Asia

signals.what: Joined the Digital Intermediate Frequency Interoperability (DIFI) Consortium

fit_rationale: Baku hosts a Grand Prix, and Azercosmos sells satellite capacity to broadcasters and telecoms across Europe, Africa and Asia; a race-linked media or hospitality role in Baku is plausible.
outstanding: No revenue or route evidence found; 200 employees. Check whether the Baku GP promoter already uses it.

name: Es'hailSat
desc: Qatari satellite operator founded in 2010 whose Es'hail 1 and Es'hail 2 satellites carry direct-to-home TV for beIN Sports and Al Jazeera across MENA.
products: Satellite capacity for broadcasting and communications (Es'hail 1, Es'hail 2; Es'hail-3/Türksat-Biruni from 2030)
customers: beIN Sports, Al Jazeera, broadcasters and telecom operators in MENA
expansion_markets: Ka-band capacity at 50° East with Türksat (launch 2030)

signals.what: Contract with Thales Alenia Space to build Es'hail-3/Türksat-Biruni Ka-band satellite (project valued at EUR 295m)

fit_rationale: Carries beIN Sports, a major F1 broadcaster in MENA, and Qatar hosts a Grand Prix; a broadcast-technology partnership at Lusail is conceivable.
customer_overlap: beIN Sports (F1 broadcaster in MENA) is a customer
outstanding: Ownership (not stated on page), revenue, employees; no route shown.
